headline: A ground delay program is holding flights into San Francisco.

items.text: The FAA has a ground delay program in effect for flights into San Francisco (SFO) until 8:59 PM PT, because of low clouds. Those flights are held at their departure airport; delays average 45 minutes, up to 110 minutes.
The other hubs are running normally, and all seven reporting so far today are at 84% on time or better, meaning within 30 minutes of schedule.

A ground delay program is also in effect for flights into Seattle (SEA) until 9:59 PM PT; those flights are held at their departure airport, with delays averaging 32 minutes, up to 82 minutes. The FAA's operations plan lists 4 possible or planned programs for later, and none of them is in effect now.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to San Francisco or Seattle, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
